status_semantics.INTERFACE_DEFINED_NOT_EXECUTED: Handoff intent and ownership are documented, but no runtime dispatch has been observed.
status_semantics.STATIC_ROUTING_TESTED: Central registry, positive/negative route and ownership assertions passed in repository CI.
status_semantics.SCHEMA_CONTRACT_TESTED: A concrete payload fixture was validated against the versioned handoff JSON Schema.
status_semantics.HOST_ACTIVATION_TESTED: Routing was tested on a named host and version.
status_semantics.RUNTIME_VERIFIED: A real end-to-end invocation and returned artifact were observed and evidenced.
